title: video block props
description: A video file: played by the learner with its controls (captions and a transcript), or as a muted loop like an animated image (loop: true, with alt), or decorative.
x-ai-instructions: Short segments controlled by the learner (E3), never autoplayed with sound. A video with sound needs captions (WebVTT) and a transcript (F3); a video without sound needs a transcript or alt. A short silent animation (a process, a gesture) plays as a loop: loop: true with alt saying what it shows. A video that carries no information (an ambiance, a background) is decorative: true. The validator reports what is missing.

title.description: Shown under a video played with its controls, which it names for assistive technologies; names a loop in the editor.

captions.description: WebVTT captions file (.vtt). Required when the video is played with its sound.

transcript.description: What is said and shown, for those who cannot watch or hear it. Required for a video played with its controls (a silent one may give alt instead).

loop.description: Plays muted, in a loop, like an animated image: it starts by itself unless the learner prefers reduced motion, and a button pauses it. Its sound is never heard: no captions.

alt.description: Text alternative of a loop or of a video without sound: what it shows. Required for a loop unless decorative.

decorative.description: True only if the video carries no information: it plays as a loop, ignored by assistive technologies, with nothing to caption, transcribe or describe.
